commit.title: obu: don't extend the order hint of closed-loop key frames
commit.message:
obu: don't extend the order hint of closed-loop key frames

AVM's get_disp_order_hint_keyobu() takes the coded order hint of a
closed-loop key frame as its display order hint. dav2d extended it
against the references the key frame drops, so a closed-loop key frame
coded more than half the order hint range after the last shown frame
(e.g. order hint 0 after frame 68, with 7-bit order hints) got POC 128
instead of 0, and the frames after it were set up with the wrong
references and failed to parse.

28e39df9 handled the output side of #91; this is the POC part of it.

closed-loop key frame as its display order hint. dav2d extended it
against the references the key frame drops, so a closed-loop key frame
coded more than half the order hint range after the last shown frame
(e.g. order hint 0 after frame 68, with 7-bit order hints) got POC 128
instead of 0, and the frames after it were set up with the wrong
references and failed to parse.

28e39df9 handled the output side of #91; this is the POC part of it.
